audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer builds the whole lane around tracking Courage (W) and the Level 1 why is boilerplate about your Q-poke winning while the side is Garen.
audit.why: Courage is a defensive shield; the ability that decides the lane is Decisive Strike (Q, 8s) — it silences your combo, empowers an auto and gap-closes, with Judgment (E, 9s at rank 1) as the damage.
audit.corrected: TL;DR, win condition, enemy win and the Level 1 why re-pointed at Decisive Strike and Judgment.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item phase is Iceborn Gauntlet boilerplate tied to Courage's cooldown.
audit.why: Judgment is physical damage, so the armour item is the actual spike and it is what flips the duel.
audit.corrected: First-item phase now names Judgment as the reason armour flips the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Decisive Strike breaks free of all slows, which means it removes your Seismic Shard slow, and the silence half is only in the content layer.
audit.why: Riot's description: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him, and his next attack silences. Your Q slow is his to delete on an 8s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Interaction written into Key Ability Interactions, the cooldown block and the level-3 why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block has no numbers and points at the wrong ability.
audit.why: Decisive Strike 8s flat, Judgment 9s at rank 1 down to 6s, Courage 22s down to 12s, Demacian Justice 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written in with Decisive Strike as the tracked ability.

edits.before: Build armor — your resists gut his AD spin, E-slow him. Malphite wins the Courage cooldown windows.
edits.after: Build armour — resists gut Judgment, E-slow his autos. Malphite wins the Decisive Strike windows.

edits.before: Build armor and out-trade his spin. Track Courage before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Build armour and out-trade the spin. Track Decisive Strike before every commit and hold the wave your side.

edits.before: Garen wins by landing Courage, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Garen wins by landing Decisive Strike, silencing your combo, and spinning through your trades.

edits.before: Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds. Identify how Garen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Decisive Strike gap-closes and silences you while Judgment chips, and you have no W or E yet. Last-hit and let Granite Shield soak.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Courage's cooldown.
edits.after: Your first armour item is the flip — Judgment is physical, so every point of it eats his spin.

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction. Trade when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Decisive Strike (Q): 8s flat — it silences you and breaks his slows, so hold your combo until it is spent. - Judgment (E): 9s at rank 1. - Demacian Justice (R): 120/100/80 true damage. - Your ultimate: 130s.

edits.before: Track Garen's Courage: Damage reduction. Trade when down. When it is down — R-W-E him.
edits.after: Decisive Strike (Q, 8s) silences your combo and breaks free of your Seismic Shard slow.

edits.before: Damage reduction. Trade when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Silences you and breaks your slow, 8s flat. Commit once it is spent.

edits.before: Once your W/E come up it evens out — your armor starts eating his AD spin and your E slows his autos.
edits.after: Your W/E even it out, but Decisive Strike still breaks your Q slow every 8s and silences the answer.

notes: Demacian Justice deals true damage, so the armour you stack does not reduce it — already stated in the content layer and left intact. Malphite's kit derives a 'grounding' flag on Seismic Shard and Ground Slam that Riot's descriptions do not support; no grounding claim written. The packet's suspectNames for this matchup (Unstoppable Force, Decisive Strike) are false positives — both are the correct Riot names.
